.. _EXPIRE:

EXPIRE
======

Sets Time to Live (TTL) for the scheduled deletion of an audio stream.

Arguments
---------

+-------------+------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+
| Name        | Type       | Description                                                   |
+=============+============+===============================================================+
| stream_id   | ``string`` | ASCII ID of the audio stream.                                 |
+-------------+------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+
| ttl         | ``int``    | Time to Live (TTL) of audio stream in seconds.                |
+-------------+------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+

Input
-----

+----------+--------------------------------------------+
| Type     | Description                                |
+==========+============================================+
| ``null`` | N/A                                        |
+----------+--------------------------------------------+

Output
------

+----------+--------------------------------------------+
| Type     | Description                                |
+==========+============================================+
| ``null`` | N/A                                        |
+----------+--------------------------------------------+

Example
-------

.. code-block:: none

   EXPIRE 'vocals' 30
